Developing a strong mind-muscle connection is perhaps the most important consideration in regard to repetition duration. By focusing on actively contracting the target muscle throughout the range of motion of a given exercise, maximal mechanical forces are directed to the musculature, heightening the degree of stimulation.

Abbreviations: RM = repetition maximum; DXA = dual X-ray absorptiometry; MRI = magnetic resonance imaging; CSA = cross-sectional area; FFM = fat-free mass.

Reprinted from B.J. Schoenfeld, D.I. Ogborn, and J.W. Krieger, 'Effect of Repetition Duration During Resistance Training on Muscle Hypertrophy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis, ' Sports Medicine 45, no. 4 (2015): 577-585, with kind permission from Springer Science + Business Media.
